recent.text: 3 takeaways from the game, presented by @dotvegasinc 1) VGK came with their shooting boots on tonight. recent.text: Final, 3-2 Nashville in the shootout. #VGK fall to 13-5-3. Four-game win streak snapped. Postgame Observations. - On the one hand, Vegas was pretty dominant through two periods. On the other, they had to scrape and claw late in the third just to get to OT. If not for Juuse
